mainEntity.name: Alibaba.com US Supplier Program
mainEntity.description: B2B marketplace supplier membership for US businesses to sell globally

mainEntity.name: What are the criteria to sell on Alibaba.com as a US supplier?

acceptedAnswer.text: A U.S.-registered business entity with a Certificate of Registration. Individual sellers are not eligible. Sellers must also have the capacity to supply products in wholesale quantities.

mainEntity.name: What do I get from the paid membership?

acceptedAnswer.text: As an Alibaba.com paid seller member, you get a customized storefront, 17-language support, access to 1M+ active B2B buyers, RFQ opportunities, AI-powered marketing tools, instant message translation, free onboarding, traffic boosts, advertising credits, and U.S.-based customer support. For more details, please see the full feature list above or contact our service team.

mainEntity.name: Why should I sell my products on Alibaba.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As an Alibaba.com seller, you get more than a digital storefront on a global marketplace. You get an end-to-end wholesale service platform calibrated to help you grow your business and provide services to your buyers. This is your opportunity to expand your sales with an additional revenue stream and reach new customers.

mainEntity.name: What is the next step once I have paid online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once you've paid online, our customer support team will reach out to assist you with Business Verification (BV). Once you've passed BV, we will start the onboarding process to prepare your online store launch. We will need: product images, descriptions, your company logo, and other specifics you want shown in your storefront.

mainEntity.name: What is Business Verification and is it required?

acceptedAnswer.text: After you sign up for Alibaba.com, you need to submit required documents that prove you are a legal business entity registered in the US. This process is called Business Verification and is required for selling on Alibaba.com.

mainEntity.name: How does Alibaba.com compare to Faire?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alibaba.com and Faire serve different seller needs. Alibaba.com charges a commission well below 15%, with a 6-month commission-free period for new sellers, includes KWA advertising credits to drive extra exposure, offers a fully customizable storefront, provides both self-managed and platform logistics options, and protects sellers with a 2-hour unconditional refund window after which any buyer refund requires seller approval. Faire takes 17.5% on every marketplace order, offers strong curation and a streamlined Shopify integration, provides limited storefront control, and applies a 60-day return window that shifts risk to the seller.
